title: Law to auto-enroll homeowners in lowest-cost tax payment plans
summary: This bill would require the city's Finance Department to automatically enroll eligible homeowners in the property tax payment plan that costs them the least, rather than requiring them to apply. Homeowners would get written notice at least 60 days before their first payment is due, explaining their options and how to opt out, and the system would be available in the city's designated languages. The law would take effect 120 days after being enacted.
